_comment: P1 Lighthouse CI gate. Runs in the dedicated `lighthouse` CI job (downloads headless Chrome in the GitHub runner) against the BUILT dist/ served by lhci's static server — so it never touches offline dev or the core frontend/backend jobs. The deterministic bundle gate is scripts/bundle-budget.mjs (npm run budget, gzip-exact); this adds real-browser runtime signal: performance score + render-blocking + script-weight. The category floors are conservative because Chrome can't run in the authoring environment to calibrate them — promote them upward once the first green CI run establishes the true baseline.
